Combat and equipment

Choose weapons for the trip

Before equipping yourself, decide whether you are gathering, fighting at close range or exploring a dangerous area. For everyday gathering, you can pair a melee weapon with a reliable ranged weapon. Indoor encounters call for close-range handling, while fights in open areas require attention to range.

Before unlocking a new gun, budget for both crafting materials and future ammunition. Research weapons you use often and can keep supplied with ammo; you do not need to unlock every gun at once. Even after getting more expensive equipment, keep an affordable everyday loadout.
